summary: Iteration-7 verification of (1) per-region multi-frame /api/scan and (2) mobile responsiveness. BACKEND: 9/9 pytest tests PASSED. Repeated 'frame_regions' form field now parses into a List[str] - no 422 'Input should be a valid list'. POST /api/scan region=full with 6 files + 6 repeated frame_regions (front,left,crown,right,hairline,back) returned 200 with analysis.region=='full', analysis.per_region keyed by the supplied regions (4 of 6 kept - crown/back frames were dropped by the quality<40 blur filter, which is the documented behaviour), frames_used == len(per_region), and exactly one stored image per region in Mongo whose highest-confidence frame's metrics match the per_region entry field-for-field (confidence + density_score verified). Overall blend for density/coverage/hairline/overall lies within [min,max] of the per-region values. region=crown with 4x frame_regions='crown' -> 200, per_region == {'crown': ...} only, frames_analyzed==4, frames_used<=4, and top-level density/overall equal the averaged crown values. frame_regions OMITTED entirely (region=hairline) -> 200, all stored frames tagged 'hairline', single per_region key. Unauthenticated /api/scan -> 401. GET /api/sessions/{id} returns the session with 6 attached images and analysis.per_region identical to the scan response; GET /api/timeline row for the same session also carries analysis.per_region + 6 images. No mongo _id leaked. FRONTEND (390x844): document.documentElement.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth (390) i.e. NO horizontal overflow on Landing(/), Dashboard, Upload, Timeline, Settings, Dermatologists, Report, Results and Admin(/admin as iampandasubham@gmail.com super_admin). Mobile nav (nav.md:hidden) has overflowX=auto with scrollWidth 393 > clientWidth 390 and all 5 items (nav-dashboard/upload/timeline/consult/settings-mobile) are in-view, reachable and each navigates correctly (5/5 clicks PASS). Results page renders the 'Per-region breakdown' card (data-testid=per-region) with 4 region-metric-<region> tiles (front/left/right/hairline), all inside the viewport, 2-col grid, readable. Upload auto-scan idle UI renders region-full/region-crown/region-hairline, start-scan-btn and light-btn, and light-btn toggles ('Screen light on' -> 'off'). ONE REAL MOBILE BUG FOUND: the whole auto-scan panel on /upload is 429px wide inside the 390px viewport and is silently CLIPPED by body{overflow-x:hidden} - see frontend_issues.

minor.issue: Same-day re-scan with a DIFFERENT region produces a misleading result. Verified: user had a region=full scan today (per_region: front/left/right/hairline). Posting a second scan with region=crown + frame_regions=crown reuses the same day session (get_or_create_today_session), so finalize_day_analysis re-reads ALL 8 frames of the day: the response comes back region=='crown' but per_region is STILL ['front','left','right','hairline'] with frames_used=4 - the freshly captured crown frames contribute nothing and the 'crown focus' label on Timeline/Results is wrong. Either scope finalize_day_analysis to the frames of the current scan batch, or keep accumulating but recompute `region` from the actual per_region keys.

Blur filter can silently delete whole regions from the breakdown: with 6 tagged frames only 4 survived quality>=40, so per_region had no 'crown'/'back' entry and the response gives the client no signal about which regions were rejected. Consider returning a `regions_dropped` list so the UI can prompt a re-scan of that area.

ui_bugs.issue: HORIZONTAL CLIPPING on mobile (390px). The grid child div.lg:col-span-2 measures 429px wide inside a 350px-wide grid parent (right edge = 449px) and every descendant reaches right=424px, so the right ~35-60px is cut off by body{overflow-x:hidden}. Clipped content: card right borders, the region tip texts ('Sweep the phone slowly over your whole head.', 'Tilt your head down and hover over the top-back.', 'Hold at forehead height, panning across the front.'), the 'Tip: uses your selfie camera...' box, 'Move for 30s while it captures...' and the right half of light-btn ('Screen light on/off'). ROOT CAUSE: grid items default to min-width:auto, and the sibling card (line 311) has a fixed style={{width:260}} preview plus a non-wrapping `flex items-center gap-3` row holding start-scan-btn (203px) + light-btn (164px) = ~379px + p-6 (48px) = 427px min-content, which inflates the single mobile column track for BOTH cards. FIX: add `min-w-0` to both grid children and make the button row wrap (e.g. `flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch gap-3 w-full` / `flex-wrap`). Note the document-level overflow check still passes only because overflow-x is hidden - the content is genuinely unreachable.

Stale copy after the per-region change: 'Auto-scan captures many photos as you move, then averages all the sharp ones for a stable result.' The client now keeps only the SHARPEST photo per sub-region (~6 uploaded), so 'averages all the sharp ones' is inaccurate (the in-card copy on line 319 'we keep the sharpest photo of each area' is correct).

action_items: HIGH: Fix /upload mobile clipping - add min-w-0 to the two children of `grid lg:grid-cols-5 gap-6` in Upload.jsx and let the start-scan/light button row wrap (flex-col sm:flex-row or flex-wrap w-full).

MEDIUM: /api/scan same-day cross-region re-scan mislabels the result (region=crown but per_region = previous full-scan regions, new frames ignored). Scope finalize_day_analysis to the current batch or derive `region` from per_region keys.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py auto_scan: `frame_regions: List[str] = Form([])` correctly consumes the repeated multipart field - verified no 422. Positional alignment `sub = regions_in[i] if i < len(regions_in) else region` is index-based against `files[:36]`, but frames are SKIPPED (continue) when empty/oversized/unprocessable BEFORE being appended - the index used for the region lookup is the enumerate index of the original files list, so alignment survives skips. Correct.

server.py finalize_day_analysis: the `len(by_region) <= 1` branch averages the top-4 by confidence, the else branch takes the single best-confidence frame per region. Because it queries ALL frames of the day session, a second same-day scan of another region mixes batches - see backend minor issue.

server.py finalize_day_analysis line 316: `usable = [...] or frames` silently falls back to ALL frames (including blurry ones) if every frame is below quality 40 - the resulting analysis then has no quality signal for the user. Consider surfacing a low-quality warning instead.

Upload.jsx: grid children lack min-w-0, which is the root cause of the mobile clipping; CSS-level `overflow-x: hidden` on body/#root masks the symptom from a scrollWidth assertion but not from the user.

Results.jsx per-region card is correctly gated on `Object.keys(a.per_region).length > 1`, so single-region (crown/hairline) scans intentionally hide it; region-badge is intentionally hidden when region==='full'. Both verified as designed.

rca_of_the_issue: Mobile clipping RCA: index.css sets overflow-x:hidden on html/body/#root, which removes the horizontal scrollbar but does not stop children from being laid out wider than the viewport. On /upload the container `div.grid lg:grid-cols-5 gap-6` collapses to one implicit column on mobile; CSS grid items have min-width:auto, so the column track grows to the largest child's min-content width. The right-hand card contains a fixed 260px preview and a non-wrapping button row (start-scan-btn 203px + gap 12px + light-btn 164px = 379px) plus p-6 padding (48px) => 427px min-content, forcing the track (and therefore BOTH cards) to 429px inside a 350px content box. Result: ~35-60px of every element in the panel is clipped, including half of light-btn and all region tip texts. Fix = min-w-0 on the grid children + a wrapping/stacked button row. Backend per-region RCA: finalize_day_analysis re-aggregates every frame in the day's tracking_session, so it cannot distinguish scan batches; a same-day crown re-scan therefore returns the earlier full-scan's per_region while labelling the analysis region='crown'.
